name: ellines-eip
description: Ellines EIP (Enterprise Intelligence Platform) — Where Enterprise Systems Think Together

scripts.dev: concurrently -n identity,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:identity" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build:shared: npm run build -w @ellines-eip/shared && npm run build -w @ellines-eip/connectors-sdk
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @ellines-eip/web
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build:web && npm run deploy:pages -w @ellines-eip/web
